To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) The synthesis of C2 - and C3 -symmetric benzotriacarboxamide-based molecules containing oligodimethylsiloxy and/or alkyl chains is described.
the aggregation behavior of the oligodimetilsiloxane-based benzetracarboxamides is strongly dependent on the bulkiness of their oligodimetilsioxane side chains and on their chiral properties.
we have designed a new class of self-assembled C3- and C2-symmetric benzene-1,3,5-tri carboxamides containing well-defined oligo dimethyl siloxane (o DMS) and alkyl side chains.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and characterization of a new family of C3 - or C2 -symmetrical oligodimethyl-siloxane-based benzotricarboxamide derivatives.
the synthesis of a series of oligo(dimethylsiloxane)-substituted benzene-1-3-5-tricarboroxamides (BTACs).
the design, synthesis, and self-assembly of C2 - and C3 -symmetric benzotriazole-based oligodimethyl-siloxane-containing organogelators and liquid crystals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the oDMS chain length is the most important structural feature in the self-assembly process of these compounds.
the presence of oDMS chains is not necessary for organogelation and the presence of alkyl chains is enough.
the oligo(o-dimethylsiloxanes) are a new and interesting building block for the design of supramolecular architectures with interesting properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of oDMS chains leads to a decrease of the clearing temperature and to the formation of superlattices within the hexagonal columnar structure.
by using the oDMS chain we can control the supramolecular aggregation and self-assembly of these molecules.

we have been able to synthesize a new class of C2 - and C3 -symmetric oligo(o-dimethylsiloxanes) based benzene-1,3,5-tri-carboxamides (oDMS-BTAS) with a wide range of oligodimethyl-siloxanes (oDMS), alkyl and aromatic chains.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of oligodimethyl-siloxanes in a C2 -symmetrical BTA can induce the formation of superlattices with potential applications in nanoimprint lithography.
it is possible to design and prepare C2 - and C3 -symmetric benzotrifluorides with well-defined oligodmethylsiloxane and alkyl chains.
the introduction of oligodimethylsioxane chains in the BTA backbone is a simple and versatile method to control the aggregation and self-assembly properties of the BTA molecules.
